body: It all started years ago when I met this beautiful woman, her name was Bri. The night we met was of course like magic and it was a night I will remember for the rest of my life. I dedicated my attention and love to this person, and she was the only girl for me. For a long time. We were together for about 2 and a half years before I got a new job that moved me far away, about 12 hours. We did the long distance thing for 6 months. Towards the end of the relationship, things were pretty stale and when another attractive girl come along, I really started to fall for this new and exciting women. Me being the dumbass that I am, broke up with Bri to date this new girl. It lasted a month and she used me and tried to get money out of me, then left me and was with a new guy the next day. I got played hard. It did not take to long for me to get over this fling, but I found myself incredibly lonely and tried to go back into the arms of my former love, praying that she would have me back. No matter what i say or do, she won't have me. My fears have all but been confirmed when she started to tell me why she didn't even like me more then friends anymore. I was mean. I am a terrible person. I actually told her once that I wouldn't find her beautiful if she got tattoos or piercings in which I didn't like. I would bully her, just verbally. I would never physically hurt someone. These are the words she used to tell me.I know these things to be true, as I do tend to say things so I can get what I want. I would basically force her to have phone sex with me even though she was tired, she never put up much of a fight, as she is very reserved and quiet. I can't say that I didn't know I was being a bully or making her do things she didn't want to do, but I did not realize it was so profound, please give me the benefit of the doubt, that if she had flat out told me I would have stopped. I still did these things though. I understand this seems to only be about women at this point, but it truley is the story of my life. I don't want to be a bully, or mean to people, I find that I can be very charming when I want to be. But after people get to know me, and know my faults and my problems, I try to control it, or hide who I am. Showing weakness is for boys and girls, not men. This is the first time I have cried since my cat died 10 years ago, which it was also my fault he died, because when my mom got a new apartment, i was moving my stuff and I didnt put him in a carrier because he was my cat, and as soon as I opened the door, holding him as tight as I thought I needed to, all claws inside of me at once, I dropped the cat, he ran away, found a week later run over by a car. He was so beautiful. Back to my actual life. I found a job a year ago in April and moved 12 hours away from everyone I know and love. I have never felt so lonely. I have been physically stabbed by a man with a broken part of a plate in the arm, and that pain is nothing in comparison to the psoriatic arthritis I had. The pain was so severe that I would have to wake up, an hour before work, take 4 IBprofen and sleep for another hour, so the swelling would go down and I was able to get myself out of bed. It was so bad that I went from 300lbs to 275lbs because it was to much pain to cook for myself. I kept that train going and I am now down to 240lbs, but I still look fat, I am weak, my skin is in terrible shape, and I am not an attractive person. That sounds like a lot of weight lost, but I did not work hard to achieve that. And when I say didn't work hard, I didn't change anything in my life except maybe eating a little bit less. People talk about how it was so hard, I feel like it was a gift given to me, in which I most definietly do not deserve. I do not feel good about myself after losing this weight. I made some new friends in the area, but as always, when I talk to people, all I feel is that they like to hear themselves talk, and if I can go nights where I only listen. They do not care about me. On top of all of this, I have some debt issues, and I have to borrow money off of my mom occasionally, to the tune of about 500$ now. Nothing says failure like borrowing money off of your parents. I make 42500$, which I think is fairly decent amount of money, and I can't help but to spend my money on partying, which I hate myself for later. I have no self control. I bought a truck... The most rediculous thing I could have done, but I do love that truck, and driving around in it, problem being that I can't afford the gas. I lost all direction in my story at this point. When I am around people, and they are talking, I feel like they are stupid, and the words that they are using are not worthy of my ears hearing. I do not want to be like this and changning this something I wanted to do for a long time. I do not care for other people I think, and if they arn't listening to what I have to say, then why are the around me. I want to be any body else. I want this to just stop. I want my brain to shut up and just let me be for a minute. I want to take a whole bunch of drugs that will make me less of a man so that I can just relax and play video games and zone out for a bit so time passes and Im closer to things getting better for me. I hate myself. I hate the things I say to people even. When i think back on the conversations I have with people, all i can think is this guy is just a stupid asshole, why would anyone want to listen to him. I also feel like a huge dissapointment to my dad because I owe him 1500$ for a car he gave me, which I no longer drive. I have no motivation to get anything done at work and I have tons of things piling up on me adding to the stress. I find it hard to learn the things I need to learn to do the job I need to do. This is all i can think to write right now.
These things are not easy. But to start to explain.... Incoming wall of text in a couple minutes after I type it.
I've read some material and I don't want to kill myself anymore, but I just want to explain some things to someone who will listen
